  Scenario: AC7 The load is refused whole when the handover is absent or does not match (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data cutover handover for the cutover business date is absent, unreadable, or its row count or checksum does not match
    When the load runs for the cutover business date
    Then the load is refused before any row is written
    And the load report names the file and the date

  Scenario: AC8 A handover row with a missing field or an invalid value is refused and listed (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a handover row with no matched_to, or with a value outside LOV-MATCH or LOV-PROCEEDS-SRC, and the other rows of the handover are valid
    When the load runs for the cutover business date
    Then the row is refused and listed with its entity and its field under MSG-GEN-001
    And the other rows of the handover are loaded

  Scenario: AC9 The version fails when the proceeds baseline is absent (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the environment where the proceeds baseline is absent
    When the version is applied
    Then the version fails before the load runs
    And nothing is loaded and the report names the baseline
